purpose: Per-cell historical method for the 30 published T4 cells, so two further independent replicates clone the method that ran rather than today's defaults.
read_only: No network, no Modal, no oracle calls were used to build this.

seed_model.docking_seed: contract['docking_seed'], passed to qvina02 by t4_docking_adapter.dock_t4
places_a_seed_enters: cell.controller_seed -> the per-cell controller RNG (parent selection, exploration)
cell.controller_seed -> every proposal_seed via the formula above
RESUMED RUNS restore rng_state from the checkpoint, so a resumed controller stream does NOT restart from controller_seed -- a replicate that only sets the seed will not reproduce a resumed trajectory
seed_model.conformer_generation_is_UNSEEDED: obabel --gen3D takes no seed; the frozen result's docking_reproducibility_caveat measures a 1.3 kcal/mol spread on one molecule across three runs. Cloning every seed here does NOT make a per-row docking value reproducible.

terminal_statuses.candidate_exhaustion: published when the round's selected batch is empty (`if not selected:`) -- the search stops with budget left
terminal_statuses.complete_budget: published when the round loop exits having consumed the budget
terminal_statuses.root_oracle_failure: published when the single root docking returns score None

stopping_rule.budget_mechanics: SearchState.budget starts at contract['charged_calls_per_cell']; the root docking charges 1 before the loop; each round charges len(observed)
stopping_rule.replicate_rule: clone the CEILING and these terminal conditions. Never clone a realized charged-call count -- it is an outcome of the stopping rule, not an input.

attempts.status: no result.json and no checkpoint.json were ever published

ceiling_derivation.basis: one prior attempt published a root lock carrying exactly one query and never docked it; the call is forfeited, not free
ceiling_derivation.distinction_from_braf_and_fa7: braf_1 at 248 and fa7_2 at 249 were debited for calls that DOCKED and returned a score; this cell is debited for a call that was reserved and never docked. The unifying rule is stated above: debit every call the round-lock policy has consumed, in either form.
ceiling_derivation.ledger_null_is_not_zero: the reconciliation ledger records reconciled_charged_calls null for this row because there is no result.json to read, NOT because no call was charged
ceiling_derivation.rule: 250 authorized per cell minus every call the round-lock policy has consumed on this cell, docked or forfeited
ceiling_derivation.why_not_250: the round-lock policy is publish_before_docking with automatic_retries 0, no_backfill and never_resubmit_reserved_or_missing_query_receipt. A published lock RESERVES its query and _resume_state debits every query of a lock above the last checkpoint in full and never re-docks it, so the reserved call can never be recovered by any mode. Treating it as free would make an uncertain call a free call, which the runtime-correctness rule forbids. Under-claiming by one call is the safe direction and matches the committed finding in diagnostics/t4_held_target_5ht1b_2_d04_recovery_blocked_v1.json (correct_relaunch_allowance 249, forfeited_calls 1, ledger_null_is_not_zero).

label_audit.detail: The frozen table's source='support_expansion' covers BOTH the region-repair operator (proposal.shallow.region_law='free_gate_margin_v1', an extra key on the EXISTING shallow lane) and the protonation operator (an entirely NEW fourth proposal lane 'protonation_aware_retained_subgraph' with 17 settings, plus expert_floor_rounds REPLACED by cold_start_floor_rounds=1, a different route checkpoint, and route_complete_region pool_size 64->192 / realization_limit 64->96 with training_split REMOVED). The protonation contract itself asserts 'THIS ARM USES THE PROTONATION-AWARE PROPOSAL, NOT THE REGION-REPAIR LAW ... the two mechanisms must never be mixed in one arm or the mechanism becomes unattributable'. The shared label defeats that separation at reporting time.
label_audit.third_meaning_of_the_same_string: 'support_expansion' is ALSO the name of an unrelated module, compose_v4.experiments.t4_support_expansion, used in the fa7_0 escalation run. That module contributed NO row to this table -- FA7 seed 1 at delta 0.6 is blank. So the string denotes three different things across the record.
